standard.summary: 设置全局随机种子，确保训练的可复现性。相同 seed + 相同配置 = 相同结果。
standard.effect: 影响数据采样顺序、噪声生成、权重初始化等所有随机操作。默认 42。
standard.whenToUse: 需要复现实验结果时。对比不同超参数时固定 seed 确保公平。
standard.avoidWhen: 想增加训练多样性时可以用不同 seed 跑多次取平均。

standard_en.summary: Sets the global random seed so that training is reproducible. The same seed plus the same configuration = the same result.
standard_en.effect: It affects every random operation: the data sampling order, noise generation, weight initialisation and so on. Defaults to 42.
standard_en.whenToUse: When you need to reproduce an experimental result. Fix the seed when comparing hyperparameters, to keep the comparison fair.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When you want more variety in training, run several times with different seeds and average.

advanced.principle: 设置 torch.manual_seed、torch.cuda.manual_seed_all、numpy.random.seed、random.seed。确保所有随机源一致。DataLoader 的 worker 使用 seed + worker_id 作为各自的种子。
advanced.intervention: 训练启动时设置全局种子。
advanced.expectedImpact: 确保完全可复现。不影响训练质量。
advanced.tradeoffs: 某些 CUDA 操作（如 atomicAdd）在不同 GPU 架构上可能不完全确定性。

advanced_en.principle: Sets torch.manual_seed, torch.cuda.manual_seed_all, numpy.random.seed, and random.seed, ensuring all random sources agree. DataLoader workers use seed + worker_id as their own seeds.
advanced_en.intervention: Sets the global seed at training startup.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Ensures full reproducibility; does not affect training quality.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Some CUDA operations (e.g. atomicAdd) may not be fully deterministic across GPU architectures.
